description: proposeProductEdit for up to 50 products of one rikma in one call. A proposal belongs to one product (that is how editObject works: one decision per object, with its own clock and vote), so each product gets its own proposal — or applies at once when it is personal. Every item is answered on its own (results[i]); one failing item never stops the others. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#proposeProductEditsBatchTool

categories.description: Replace the categories (ids from listRikmaCategories). Operational — applied at once.

pricingMode.description: Personal products only: a rikma product's pricing mode changes its recipe and is changed in the moach.

reason.description: Why — shown to the partners on the proposal.

projectId.description: Rikma (project) id, from findUserProjectsTool. You must be a member.
